name: Dating Other Races
overview: Scripture affirms that marriage is a God-ordained union between a man and a woman, designed for companionship and unity as seen in Genesis 2:18 and 2:24. While God values faithfulness and purity in relationships, He also commands His people to avoid intermarriage with ungodly nations to preserve spiritual distinctiveness, as stated in Deuteronomy 7:3 and reflected in Leviticus 19:19. The example of Moses marrying an Ethiopian woman (Numbers 12:1) illustrates that God’s principles transcend ethnic boundaries, and Acts 10:34 emphasizes that God shows no partiality, focusing instead on the heart and obedience.
